full_judgment: 20. Apart from this, it is the plaintiff who is required to prove his title and possession by proving his claim which is not done here. So far the findings of the trial Court is concerned, the wife of Gayazuddin filed solenama admitting the title of the plaintiff over the suit land although PW 1 stated that she is not aware about the contents of solenama. However, mere filing of solenama regarding any property, title cannot be conferred in favour of the recipient of the Solenama as the plaintiff is to get title by his own account. The findings and reasonings regarding mode of possession of the plaintiff in the suit land is not substantiated by the evidence on record.
